|quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Contagion''' is a chaos [[spell]] that applies a chaos [[damage over time]] effect to all enemies in the area, and spreads itself when an enemy dies. Contagion interacts favourably with {{il|Essence Drain}}, a skill that deals heavy chaos damage over time and is spread by Contagion. ==Skill functions and interactions== *{{c|mod|Modifiers to Spell Damage apply to this skill's Damage Over Time Effect}}: Modifiers to spell damage only affect the damage over time effect of Contagion granted by the gem and do not affect other sources of damage over time caused by the skill. *'''{{il|Essence Drain}}''': When an enemy affected by both Contagion and Essence Drain dies, the resulting Contagion proc will spread both effects. Contagion will not spread other damage over time effects. ** This also applies to {{il|Blight of Contagion}} and {{il|Essence Drain of Desperation}}. *'''Duration''': Increases and reductions to duration function normally. The [[duration]] of Contagion and associated degeneration effects ({{il|Essence Drain}}) is not reset when spread to other enemies on death. *'''Area of Effect''': Modifiers to [[area of effect]] affect both the skill radius and spread radius of Contagion. Modifiers to area damage (such as {{il|Concentrated Effect Support}}) do not apply. *'''On hit effects''': Contagion does not [[hit]], and therefore cannot activate the effects of supports such as {{il|Hextouch Support}}. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression | c1_abbr = Chaos
